name: proof-of-green
description: Flags when Claude says tests pass, done or fixed but never ran the tests after its last edit. Local, no blocking.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: observe (default): record only, never speak. warn: one-line notice when a claim has no evidence after the last edit.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: Optional. Your project's full test command (e.g. 'make ci'). Runs containing it count as full-suite runs.
